steps: UI: owner (test wallet 8WVm…) filled beneficiary + 0.1 SOL and pressed '15s Escrow for testing': initialize
UI: the same button's second tx, deposit 0.1 SOL
UI: owner pressed Cancel on that escrow: cancel, funds back
UI: beneficiary (test wallet AgrL…) opened the app and pressed Claim after the deadline: claim
deposit 0.02 SOL into the escrow PDA
claim after the deadline → beneficiary received 0.02118872 SOL, escrow closed
evidence.functional_evidence: initialize, deposit and beneficiary claim landed on devnet. A Check In through the UI was not captured in that run; the scripted path of the program worked.
evidence.ui_check: Driven in headless Chromium with an injected Wallet Standard test wallet (tests/devnet/wallet_click.py, log tests/devnet/logs/ui-clicks-2026-11-10.jsonl): the wallet connected from the Connect button, the dashboard listed the owner's escrows, and create, cancel and the beneficiary's claim all went through the app's own buttons.

limitations: A successful Check In through the UI was not captured: the 15s/30s test escrows expire before the extension lands, and a date-picked escrow was not created. The beneficiary claims from their own wallet, because the app's IDL makes the beneficiary sign claim.
